issues.issue: The whole line is recorded under general government. The rule for statements listed by object is to use each fund column's function, as was done for Personnel services. That would put Street 20,058 under streets/highways and Library 3,016 under culture/recreation. The extractor did not split it because the columns add to 72,026, not the printed 72,025, so this is a judgment call. Splitting would need a $1 adjustment.

This line is 11% of governmental receipts. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows 'Pass Thru Income & Expense - Legion (23,574)' next to 'Other receipts 29,473', so most of it may be American Legion pass-through money matching the 23,574 pass-through expense. A person should confirm what the line holds.
Recorded in the last-resort category other. It is a pass-through payment to the American Legion; general government (payment to another entity) is a possible alternative.
